Package com.eloview.sdk.networkManager

Class CertificateConfig

java.lang.Object
com.eloview.sdk.networkManager.CertificateConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.os.Parcelable
public class CertificateConfig extends Object implements android.os.Parcelable
This is a model class which used to keep the certificate configuration data. User saves certificate configuration into this class and provides to @Network.installLocalCertificate(android.content.Context, com.eloview.sdk.networkManager.CertificateConfig) API.

It consist below information for CA and USER CERTIFICATE installation.
For e.g.

  • certificateName: test
  • certificateType: CA/USER CERTIFICATE
  • certificatePassword: password (required for the USER_CERTIFICATE
  • certificateFilePath : /sdcard/certificate.pem
